overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole held its seventh preliminary budget meeting for fiscal year 2027, reviewing department proposals and keeping the budget paper in committee.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2027 Budget Overview
items.summary: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn presented an overview of the proposed $218.2 million general fund and $30.0 million water and sewer enterprise fund operating budgets.

items.title: Parking Department Budget
items.summary: Parking Director Sarah McDermod presented the department's budget, noting a net increase in professional services due to citation system contracts and merchant processing fees.

items.title: Medford Police Department Budget
items.summary: Lieutenant Joseph Gagliardi and Captain Paul Covino presented the police budget, which includes a 17.24% salary increase to fund settled collective bargaining agreements.

items.title: Medford Public Schools Budget
items.summary: Superintendent Suzanne Galusi, Finance Director Noel Velez, and Budget Analyst Gerry McCue presented the school operating budget proposal and discussed a projected $2.18 million deficit.

items.title: Department of Public Works Budget
items.summary: DPW Director Tim McGivern presented the public works general fund and enterprise fund budgets, highlighting progress in lead line removal, roadway paving, and waste contracts.

subject: FY 2027 Preliminary Budget Hearings
